answer: Opening a challenge burns a deposit of 69 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. Because the tide deposit is held in the ledge escrow, the haven audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases as a result burns capital on every one it does not finish. That is 19 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
